page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. A marginal note stands in the left margin beside the second paragraph. At the foot, a catchword stands at the right below the last line.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. Inter Lavic. & Amas

main_text.p: armis Saxonum, de Edsardi, Geldri, Burgundorum imperio,summatim agam; pòst de αὐτονομίᾳ & præclaro jure civitatis addam nonnulla : postremò ordinem Magistratuum & cæterarum curationum in urbe & extra urbem, totamque formam regiminis civilis exponam. Ager sic habet, quemadmodum & in Historiæ libro primo exposui.

Agrifius & facies.Post Lavicæ æstuarium, & alveum ejus penè emortuum, Ostergoæ ac totius Frisiæ Occidentalis terminum, ad quem Visuleta vicus celebris & cœnobium Gerriconium sunt, ager hic noster, de quo agimus, venientibus ab occasu sequitur, longoque litoris tractu non minùs quinis milliaribus secundum latus boreum, ac vadosa æstuaria in ortum porrigitur. Inde in meridiem se referens Amasi fluminis ostio, ac sinu Dullarto, quem à fluctuum rabie sic nominant, ortivo latere claditur, sed sinuosis admodum ac varie flexis litoribus. Nam primùm à septentrionibus, ubi sensim per aliquot passuum millia descendit ad portum fere Delfilanum[?], inde rursum in ortum tum

page.notes: The line "tum fere Delfilanum" is crossed by a horizontal stain or rule, so "Delfilanum" (probably Delfzilanum) is doubtful. The Greek word "αὐτονομίᾳ" is read from a small scan and may be slightly off in its accents. "Pòst" keeps its printed grave accent. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The margin note and the catchword "tum" are as printed. Faint library marking at the bottom right is excluded.
